pool.text: A short-lived British penal settlement was established at Port Phillip by the colony.
Melbourne was founded with the arrival of free settlers from Van Diemen's Land.
Melbourne was incorporated as a Crown settlement and named after William Lamb.
Queen Victoria declared Melbourne to be a city.
Melbourne became the capital of the newly separated Colony of Victoria.
The Melbourne International Exhibition was held in the large purpose-built Exhibition Building.
Flinders Street station achieved the status of world busiest passenger station
The Manchester Unity Building was completed, showcasing Art Deco influence.
Melbourne hosted the Summer Olympics alongside other annual sporting events.
The AACTA Awards were inaugurated at the Melbourne International Film Festival.
The Sidney Myer Music Bowl hosted the largest crowd for a music concert.
Melbourne's Countdown began airing and helped launch the careers of local acts.
The abstract sculpture Vault was added to Melbourne's public artworks.
International comedy festival established as one of the three largest worldwide
Melbourne Food and Wine Festival began and takes place over ten days
Public transport operations were privatised through a franchising model with operational responsibilities
Melbourne held the largest population of Polish Jews and Holocaust survivors
Construction began on an international convention centre and commercial precinct.
State government set a target of twenty percent public transport mode share
Melbourne became the second UNESCO City of Literature.
